name: Fudge Magic spells
description: Sample spells for the Fudge Magic rules (Fudge SRD section 7.1), written for Fudger. Potency assumes a magician with three levels of fitting Magic Potential and a fantasy world of average mana; move it a step for richer or poorer magic. Fudge is a trademark of Grey Ghost Press.

entities.name: Light
entities.description: A glow the size of a lantern flame on the caster's hand or staff.

entities.name: Detect Magic
entities.description: Senses whether a person, thing or place has been touched by magic in the last day, and roughly how strongly.

entities.name: Read Mana
entities.description: Tells the caster how rich the mana is here, and which spells were cast nearby in the last day.

entities.name: Mend
entities.description: Joins a broken object, such as a cracked pot, a snapped rope or a torn sail.

entities.name: Speak with Animals
entities.description: The caster and one animal understand each other, though the animal only knows what animals know.

Stats.Specialization: Communication Magic, Only Affects Living Beings

entities.name: Heal Wound
entities.description: Closes one wound, moving it a level down the wound track. A Great result or better heals two levels.

entities.name: Shield
entities.description: A shimmering ward that gives +1 defensive factor against blows and missiles.

entities.name: Illusory Sound
entities.description: A noise of the caster's choice from a spot they can see: footsteps, voices, a crash.

entities.name: Disguise
entities.description: Makes the caster look like another ordinary person. Touch or a close look may give it away.

entities.name: Levitate
entities.description: Lifts the caster or a thing of about their weight slowly up or down, at walking pace.

entities.name: Fire Bolt
entities.description: Throws a bolt of flame. Hit with a Throwing roll; it has an offensive factor of +2 and sets dry things alight.

entities.name: Sleep
entities.description: One person falls asleep unless they win an opposed roll of Will against the spell's result. A shake or a wound wakes them.

Stats.Specialization: Mind Control, Only Affects Sentient Beings

entities.name: Far Sight
entities.description: The caster sees a place they know well, or a person they hold a token of, as if standing there.

entities.name: Flight
entities.description: The caster flies at running speed. Combat while flying is at -1.

entities.name: Stone to Mud
entities.description: Turns a wall or floor of stone, up to a cart's size, into thick mud.

entities.name: Raise the Dead
entities.description: Calls a spirit back into a body that died within the day. The body must be whole, and the spirit may not want to come.
